c29_results: canonical parity on an odd cycle has minimal cyclic period n

claim_boundary: semantic state cardinality is not a memory lower bound
finite interpolation is a warning, not a universal coefficient lower bound
the genus-one classification is a reduction, not a theorem against every isogeny-based algorithm
